The video segment begins with a black screen featuring text in cyan that reads, “For example, 2.3 trips around the circle in 154 seconds has period T = 154 sec / 2.3 cycles = 70 sec and frequency f= 1/ T = 1/ 70s = 0.014 Hz. For r= 50 m, the tangential velocity v = 2πr/ T = 2π(50 m) / 70 s = 4.5 m/s. The angular frequency ω = 2πf = 2π (0.014 Hz) = 0.088 Hz. The centripetal acceleration is ac = v^2/ r = (4.5 m/s)^2/ 50 m = 0.41 m/s^2,” followed by the statement, “Anyone inside the car feels thrown slightly outward.”

Next, the screen goes to black again, showing the text “Example 2,” and moves on to an outdoor scene of children playing on a yellow and blue merry-go-round. As the children sit and spin on the ride, text appears on the screen, “Start Timer.” As the merry-go-round spins, text appears on the screen, “r = 1.3 m” showing the radius of the circle. The children are wearing winter hats and coats. Next, the text reads, “Stop Timer” and “T = 2.9 seconds r= 1.3 meters.” 

The video then returns to the black background and text in cyan, showing, “For T= 2.9 s and r= 1.3 m, please supply the numbers to show that we have, 1) frequency f= 1/ T = 0.34 Hz 2) tangential velocity v = 2πr / T = 2.8 m/s 3) angular frequency ω= 2πf = 2.2 Hz 4) centripetal acceleration ac = v^2/ r = 6.0 m/s^2. The video concludes with a black screen showing “Example 3 Artificial gravity due to spinning motion.”
